facts.fact: The Namibia Standards Institution leads the national standardisation strategy; its chief executive says it has published 235 standards since its establishment in 2008 and the national stock is 275, with a target of 1,267 within three years, but the article names no standard on information technology or data.

note: No IT or data standard and no certification named; the document gives no as_of other than its published date, 2025-10-15, used for the stated stock.
